title: Q-Strata: Hierarchical Bit Allocation for Mixed-Precision Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.30564v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) assigns a different bitwidth to each linear layer of a large language model (LLM) to minimize the quantization-induced quality loss under a fixed budget, but Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models contain these layers in every expert of every MoE block, so the allocation space grows far larger than in a dense model. Existing methods either allocate within each block under a uniform per-block budget, or allocate across blocks through an additive proxy, and neither directly optimizes a model-level objective over the choices that couple the blocks. We propose Q-Strata, a bi-level allocator that ranks within-block assignments with a cheap proxy and allocates across blocks with a model-level objective evaluated on the assembled quantized model. Its inner stage caches a Pareto frontier of candidates per block over finely spaced budgets, leaving the outer stage to set one budget per block instead of a bitwidth for

translated_title: Q-Strata：面向专家混合大语言模型混合精度量化的分层比特分配方法
translated_abstract: 混合精度量化（MPQ）为大语言模型（LLM）的每个线性层分配不同的比特宽度，以在固定预算下最小化量化带来的质量损失。但专家混合模型在每个MoE块的每个专家中都包含这些线性层，因此其分配空间远大于稠密模型。现有方法要么在每个块内以统一的块级预算进行分配，要么通过可加代理在块间进行分配，两者都没有在耦合各块的决策上直接优化模型级目标。我们提出Q-Strata，一种双层分配器：它使用廉价的代理对块内分配进行排序，并在组装好的量化模型上以模型级目标进行块间分配。其内层阶段针对细粒度间隔的预算，为每个块缓存候选方案的帕累托前沿，使外层阶段只需为每个块设置一个预算，而无需为每个（专家的）线性层直接指定比特宽度……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: Q-Strata提出了一种双层分层比特分配框架，用廉价代理对块内分配排序、用模型级目标在组装后的量化模型上做块间预算分配，从而解决了MoE大语言模型混合精度量化中分配空间过大的难题。
en_tdlr: Q-Strata proposes a bi-level hierarchical bit allocation framework that ranks within-block assignments with a cheap proxy and allocates across blocks via a model-level objective on the assembled quantized model, making mixed-precision quantization scalable for MoE LLMs.
